description: This file contains API client functions for a frontend dashboard, including functions to fetch module overviews, metrics, and handle API URL resolution.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with error handling.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints or deriving minimal info.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the dashboard overview.
